summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K under CVM Instruction #44/2021 reporting routine insider securities transactions (Board of Directors, Management, Fiscal Council) for May 2026. The filing shows shareholdings and several renounce/election/sale transactions, including a sell of 136,250 common shares by Management on May 5 at R$16.80 per share for total volume R$2,289,000. No acquisition, disposal, or strategic corporate event is disclosed. This is a standard periodic disclosure of management transactions, not a special situation.
